A. Notes on Allocation Methodology
B. Notes on Insured-NY MTA (Railroad Protective Liability)
Insurance premiums are allocated using the SAP allocation code that most closely mirrors the underlying exposures that are being
insured. If an appropriate SAP allocation code is not available, the insurance premiums are allocated manually.
For example, the Workers Compensation, Fidelity Bond (Crime), Employment Practices Liability, and Fiduciary insurance policies have
a common risk exposure – the number of employees. An all-company SAP allocation code, which is based on the number of employees,
is used to allocate the premiums to all companies covered under these policies.
The Property and Property Terrorism insurance premiums are based on the replacement value of the property insured and associated
prior loss history. There is no predefined SAP allocation code that fits this risk exposure profile. Therefore, the insurance premiums are
manually allocated to all companies covered under these policies based on insurable values and loss history.
C. Notes on Property/Terrorism/Business Interruption Charges to NMP and LIPA
NM Properties (NMP) is charged a share of the Property & Terrorism premiums for its coverage under these policies.
LIPA is charged a share of the Property, Terrorism & Busi Interrp premiums for its lease of space at several NG facilities.
The New York Metropolitan Transit Authority (MTA) requires KEDNY and KEDLI to provide them with Railroad Protective Liability
insurance to allow KEDNY and KEDLI to perform their operations: work on gas distribution main installation, maintenance of systems,
as well as non-typical emergency work under Railroad Rights-of-Ways.
